Sell a membership package, day pass or single PT session at the counter while a shift is open: choose the package, find or quick-create the customer (a Self profile gets an account with a temporary password — CBR-118, CBR-31), optionally apply a voucher, choose the start date (CBR-119) and collect cash or a confirmed bank transfer. Price, VAT and discount are snapshotted. The Receptionist also sells a single PT session for today at the counter (CBR-54, CBR-60). A wrong paid order can be cancelled only within the same shift.

Sell a single or couple PT package in four steps: package & PT → weekly schedule → customer(s) → hold & collect payment. The customer (both members) must hold a membership valid today, not be frozen and be at least P-05 years old. The schedule is a Monday–Friday template with per-date overrides on the PT's slots (CBR-43, BR-40, BR-41); times the PT has not opened need "Confirmed with PT" (BR-96). Holding reserves the slots for 15 minutes (BR-93); payment by cash or transfer creates the subscription and all sessions (CBR-50, BR-97). No voucher.

Browse packages on sale (filters, sort, 8 per page) and buy a membership package or day pass online through VNPay; PT packages are shown with "buy at the counter". A failed or expired payment can be retried until the order deadline (P-09); a new order for the same package replaces the older Pending one. After payment the customer may move the start date of an unused membership once, within 7 days (CBR-119).
Apply A Voucher To An Order

Apply a discount voucher to an order — one voucher per order. Validity is checked when the code is applied: validity period, total usage, per-customer limit, minimum order value measured on the price before discount, and whether the order's package type falls inside the voucher's scope. PT packages never accept a voucher. Usage is counted on apply and returned if the voucher is removed or the order is cancelled; the voucher cannot be changed while a payment is pending.

Record each payment attempt as a transaction. Counter payments (cash/transfer) succeed immediately; online payments go through the gateway — success marks the order Paid and grants the package, failure or expiry keeps the order pending for retry. A success received for a cancelled or mismatched order is flagged for manual refund.
View one's own orders and payment attempts (20 per page, status filter) with order detail.

Open the shift, view transactions recorded in it, cancel a wrong order if needed, then compare expected cash from successful cash transactions with cash on hand; any discrepancy requires a reason before closing. The shift cannot be closed while any counter order from that shift is still Pending — each must be paid or cancelled first.

View all orders and transactions with search, payment method, order status, refund-only and date filters (10 / 20 / 50 per page), export the filtered list to Excel, and confirm refunds paid outside the system for transactions on the refund list (BR-81).

Maintain facility groups (name, category, location, unit label, image, visible / hidden) and their individual equipment items (unique code, label, placement note, status) in one master–detail screen; retire an item instead of deleting it. Quantities are computed from items (BR-104). The Receptionist views the same catalogue read-only and reports faults from it.

Report one or more broken equipment items of a facility group in two steps (BR-105); each item gets its own request and the Managers are notified. Close an In Progress request after checking the repair, with an acceptance note (BR-48).

Review maintenance requests (status tabs, 10 / 20 / 50 per page), approve with an optional note and the "set under maintenance" choice, or reject with a reason; the reporting Receptionist is notified (BR-106).

On the weekly PT schedule (week or list view), add draft slots of P-06 minutes on a 15-minute grid within opening hours, withdraw free slots, copy a week to the next week, then publish all changes in one step (BR-94, BR-95). Slots in a shift covered by the PT's leave request are locked. Slots may be published for any future date and any day of the week.

ACT: Abstract actor, parent of every actor that holds a login account (Customer, PT, Receptionist, Manager, Admin). Exists so that Log In, Log Out, Password Recovery, and Manage Personal Account are defined once instead of once per role. Guest does not inherit from this actor, since Guest has no account yet — Guest reaches Customer only through registration (UC-05), which is modeled as a note, not a generalization arrow.

A person who does not yet have an account. Browses public content (services, pricing, blog) and registers an account. Becomes a Customer once the account is active. Not a specialisation of Customer — the two actors share no use case.

A person who has an account with the gym. Buys membership packages and day passes online, tracks their own PT schedule (view only), packages, membership status, body measurements and transaction history, browses the Exercise Library, reads notifications, views the training and meal plans published by the PT and submits feedback.
Abstract actor, parent of PT and Receptionist. Exists so that leave-request submission is defined once for both roles. Never assigned a use case other than Submit Leave Request.

Publishes and withdraws slots for any future date on the weekly PT schedule, reschedules, transfers or cancels a session they cannot teach, tracks their teaching schedule, assigned clients and commission, browses the Exercise Library and submits leave requests; private notes and training plans are planned. The PT does not mark attendance — JOB-04 closes sessions. Inherits from Staff.

Front-desk operator. Sells membership packages, day passes and PT packages at the counter and creates customer profiles with login accounts (temporary password by email), collects payment, checks customers in, views the facility catalogue, reports broken equipment and closes repaired requests, freezes memberships, submits leave requests and reconciles cash at shift close.

Runs the gym. Configures system parameters, operating hours, the service package catalogue and vouchers; maintains personnel details of existing staff (full name, date of birth, specialty, experience, hire date, commission rate, resignation) but never creates staff accounts or changes a position; manages the facility catalogue and blog posts; approves or rejects customer deletion requests, leave requests and maintenance requests; views system-wide transactions and records refunds made outside the system for invalid online payments; is the only role that reads customer feedback; sends notifications; views the aggregated dashboard (without audit data). A Manager may not approve the deletion of their own customer profile Also confirms refunds of the refund list and approves leave requests (bulk or late approval).

System administrator. Creates and manages all internal accounts (Admin, Manager, PT, Receptionist), views the audit log, and views operational reports with audit metrics. Does not create customer accounts.

External system. Receives online payment requests for self-service membership and day-pass purchases (UC-22) and single PT session bookings (UC-37), and returns the payment result through the IPN. Not used for PT packages sold at the counter (UC-21).

External system (SMTP). Delivers 6-digit verification codes (registration, claim, recovery, email or phone change), temporary passwords of accounts created at the counter and the security notice to the old email. Not used for sign-in — login is email/phone plus password only, no OTP.
External system. Public wger.de API providing exercises, muscles, equipment and images for the Exercise Library (API-05); read-only, no key.
Internal timer that runs the background jobs JOB-01…JOB-08 (GBR-14) and owns UC-31.

JOBSPEC.title: 13.4 Auto-Close PT Sessions (JOB-04) — replace the whole section
JOBSPEC.purpose: Closes every PT session whose date has passed and that is still Scheduled, so the session quota and the PT commission are final. The PT never marks attendance (CBR-42).
JOBSPEC.related: UC-31, UC-32, UC-36 · Rules CBR-42, CBR-56, CBR-63, CBR-64, CBR-67, CBR-68, CBR-80, CBR-117, DBR-37, DBR-38
steps: Find sessions still Scheduled whose session date is before today, however many days late.
For each session, lock it, re-check that it is still Scheduled, and evaluate in order, stopping at the first match:
a. The session date is declared closed all day → Status = Cancelled, CancelType = GymClosed; no commission (CBR-56).
b. Nobody in the session can use the gym on that date (CBR-117; couple package: neither member) and at least one of them is frozen on that date → Status = Missed, MissedReason = MembershipFrozen.
c. Nobody in the session can use the gym on that date → Status = Missed, MissedReason = NoMembership.
d. A check-in exists on that date for the customer (couple package: for either member) → Status = CheckedIn.
e. Otherwise → Status = Missed, MissedReason = NoCheckIn.
Set IsAutoClosed = 1 and AttendanceMarkedAt = now. The time slot is not released and CommissionAmount is not recalculated; a Missed session earns it like a CheckedIn one (CBR-80).
Write the audit line in the same transaction as the session change.
Log the number of sessions per outcome.
fail: Database unreachable
Retries up to 3 times at 5-minute intervals. If it still fails, logs a critical error and waits for the next daily run. Sessions remain Scheduled until the next successful run.
Error while processing one session
Rolls back that session only and logs a warning. Other sessions are still processed. The session stays Scheduled and is processed again in the next run.
Session already changed by another process
The re-check finds it no longer Scheduled; the session is skipped.
No sessions to close
Job completes immediately with no action — this is normal and expected.

JOBSPEC.title: 13.7 Remind Managers of Leave Requests Starting Tomorrow (JOB-07) — replace the whole section
JOBSPEC.purpose: Reminds the Managers once about Pending leave requests whose leave starts tomorrow. It never approves or rejects a request (CBR-85).
steps: Find Pending leave requests whose FromDate is tomorrow and whose ReminderSentAt is empty.
In one transaction, set ReminderSentAt = now on each request that is still Pending and not yet reminded; a request reminded by an earlier run is skipped.
If at least one request was marked, send one system notification "Đơn sắp đến ngày nghỉ" to every Manager account: "Có N đơn nghỉ từ ngày mai đang chờ xử lý. Vui lòng kiểm tra và bố trí nhân sự."
Requests stay Pending; the Manager may still approve them after the leave has started (BR-86).
fail: Database unreachable
The job does not retry within the run; the next run (1 minute later) processes the same requests. Logs a critical error.
Notification cannot be written
The transaction is rolled back, ReminderSentAt stays empty and the next run tries again.
No requests due
Job completes immediately with no action — this is normal and expected.
